introduction: This script adds map layers that can be enabled via the right navigation bar at the very bottom.
readmeLink: For more information, see the full documentation.
swissimageUpdateText: This map shows when the {{layer}} map was updated for each region.
publicTransportStopsNote: Public transport stops appear as orange circular icons on the map. Click on them to create or update venues. Stops already mapped by a venue with the same name within a 75-meter radius are hidden, so only the ones still needing work are shown.

streetCheck.tabNote: Compares Waze street names against the official Swiss register and flags mismatches, with one-click fixes. Open the dedicated Street names tab to review the issues.
streetCheck.toggleEnabledTitle: Master switch: off disables scanning, the map layer and the edit-panel box
streetCheck.toggleAutoScanTitle: Scan automatically when the map moves; off = use the Rescan button
streetCheck.scanAreaTitle: Fetch the official register for the whole view, tile by tile. May take a minute or two.
streetCheck.sweepTooLarge: View too large to scan, even area by area
streetCheck.warnTruncated: {{n}} dense area(s) truncated by the register API, some official names may be missing (possible false "not found")
streetCheck.warnFailedTiles: {{n}} area(s) failed to load, affected segments were not checked
streetCheck.warnContinuationCap: lookup budget reached, some "not found" may clear on the next scan
streetCheck.rescanTitle: Clear the cache and fetch the official register again
streetCheck.locateTitle: Center the map on the segment
streetCheck.zoomToGroupTitle: Zoom the map to all segments of this group
streetCheck.geoAdminLinkTitle: Open this spot on map.geo.admin.ch (official register layer)
streetCheck.cantonMapLinkTitle: Open this spot on the {{canton}} cantonal map
streetCheck.filterChipTitle: Filter the list by this status
streetCheck.noteOwnDistance: its official axis is ~{{m}} m away
streetCheck.ignoreTitle: Hide this finding (false positive) — stored locally on this device
streetCheck.confirmOverLockFix: This segment is locked above the Swiss minimum (often intentional). Lower the lock to L{{n}}?
streetCheck.legendCOSMETIC: typography only (case, apostrophe, spacing), dashed line
streetCheck.legendVARIANT: abbreviation, missing accent or article; official spelling suggested
streetCheck.legendNEAR: probable typo; one close official name found
streetCheck.legendWRONG_TYPE: different or missing way type (Chemin ↔ Route, X → Rue X); unique official name suggested
streetCheck.legendBILINGUAL: bilingual street: primary should be one language, the other as an alternate
streetCheck.legendWRONG_STREET: valid name, but the official street underneath has another name
streetCheck.geometryMatching: Geometry matching (official street under the segment)
streetCheck.geometryMatchingTitle: Enables UNNAMED suggestions, wrong-street detection and disambiguation by distance
streetCheck.viewportOnly: Show only segments visible on the map
streetCheck.viewportOnlyTitle: Filters the list and counters to the area currently on screen (no rescan)
streetCheck.editableOnlyTitle: Hide segments locked above my editor rank
streetCheck.legendWRONG_CITY: name exists, but in another locality (city scoping)
streetCheck.legendNOT_FOUND: not found in the official register
streetCheck.legendUNNAMED: checked road type without a name; the official street underneath is suggested when found, dashed line
streetCheck.legendUNNAMED_NO_MATCH: unnamed and no official street found underneath (geometry matching) — usually legitimate
streetCheck.legendMICRO_SEGMENT: drivable segment shorter than 5 m (Swiss guideline; roundabouts excluded)
streetCheck.legendLOOP: loop made of fewer than 3 segments (same endpoints); split it
streetCheck.legendNARROW_MISUSE: Narrow Street misuse: one-way or shorter than 50 m
streetCheck.legendUNDER_LOCK: lock level below the Swiss minimum for its road type (roundabouts: at least L3)
streetCheck.legendOVER_LOCK: lock rank above the Swiss minimum (often intentional)
streetCheck.guidelineChecks: Swiss guideline checks (micro-segments, loops, narrow streets)
streetCheck.guidelineChecksTitle: Checks from the Suisse romande editing guidelines that need no external data
streetCheck.helperSetting: Issue box in the segment edit panel
streetCheck.altOk: Alternate name match counts as OK
streetCheck.altOkTitle: Useful in bilingual communes where the second language is an alternate name
streetCheck.showMapLabels: Show expected name on the map (zoom ≥ 17)
streetCheck.keepOldName: Keep old name as alternate when fixing
streetCheck.scopingTitle: Compare the segment's city with the official locality (zip_label)
streetCheck.shortcutNextIssue: Street names: select the next issue
streetCheck.shortcutFixSelected: Street names: fix the selected segment
streetCheck.errNoCity: Segment has no city; set the city first
streetCheck.errStreetCreate: Could not find or create the street record
streetCheck.errLockAboveRank: Lock L{{expected}} is above your editor level (L{{user}})
streetCheck.confirmIgnoreAll: Ignore all {{n}} findings in this group? They are hidden locally and can be restored from the settings (Reset).
streetCheck.detachTitle: Move the panel into a floating window that stays visible when WME switches to the Selection tab
streetCheck.dockTitle: Put the panel back into the sidebar tab
streetCheck.noteMatchConfidence: match {{pct}}% of the segment, {{m}} m from its axis
streetCheck.confirmWrongStreetFix:
This segment is named "{{current}}" but another official street runs underneath.
Rename it to "{{suggestion}}"?
This verdict comes from geometry, so check it on the map first.
streetCheck.confirmGroupFixDetailed:
Rename {{n}} segments from "{{current}}" to "{{suggestion}}"?
Nothing is saved automatically; review and save in WME.
streetCheck.errGroupFixRank: Fixing a whole group needs editor level {{level}} or above. Fix the segments one by one.

deleteObsoleteStop.message: The venue "{{name}}" has no matching SBB stop. Do you want to delete it?

venueMatchDialog.selectMessage: Multiple matching stops found. Choose which one to merge with:
venueMatchDialog.message:
It seems {{venueCount}} stop(s) with this name already exist.
We have selected them for you.
What would you like to do?
Selecting 
Merge
will apply the information to the existing stops without creating a new one.

hnImport.tabNote: Shows official Swiss address points from the federal building register (RegBL/GWR). Select a street, then click a green point to create its house number.
hnImport.stateZoomGated: Zoom in to load address points
hnImport.hintSelectSegment: Select the street segment first, so the number is attached to it and existing numbers can be checked.
hnImport.importedCount: {{count}} house number(s) created. Nothing is saved yet.
hnImport.errTooFar: That address is {{distance}} m from the selected street; select the right segment.
hnImport.errSegmentNotFound: The segment is no longer loaded.
hnImport.warnTruncated: Too many addresses here to list them all; bulk import is off. Individual clicks still work.
hnImport.warnIncomplete: Part of this view could not be loaded; bulk import is off. Individual clicks still work.
hnImport.legendNote: Statuses absent from the selection are not listed above.
hnImport.confirmMassImportUnverifiedName: Note: the street-name checker reports this street's name as differing from the official register. The numbers will be attached to it as it is named today.
hnImport.confirmMassImportSegments: The street is split into {{segments}} WME segments; each number is attached to the one it sits on.
hnImport.confirmMassImportReview: Once created, check the result on the map and move any number that did not land where it belongs.

speedCameraUrs.tabNote: Comments on and closes as Not identified the open URs on screen of type MISSING_STATIC_SPEED_CAMERA. Swiss law forbids showing fixed speed cameras in Waze: each reporter gets the official explanation in their language.
speedCameraUrs.stateNone: No speed-camera UR on screen. URs must be shown on the map to be found.
speedCameraUrs.conversationNote: These URs already carry a comment. They are left out of Handle all: check each one before closing it.
speedCameraUrs.rowTitle: Zoom to this UR, then click its marker to open it
speedCameraUrs.confirmCloseOnly: The official message is already in this UR's conversation. Close the UR as Not identified without sending it again?
speedCameraUrs.dlgFactSendOne: The message below goes to the reporter now.
speedCameraUrs.dlgFactCloseOne: The UR is closed as Not identified.
speedCameraUrs.dlgConversation: This UR already has a conversation. Last comment:
speedCameraUrs.dlgQuoteHint: Click a flag to see the exact text sent in that language.
speedCameraUrs.dlgWarningOne: The message is sent immediately and cannot be withdrawn.
speedCameraUrs.dlgWarningAll: The messages are sent immediately and cannot be withdrawn.
speedCameraUrs.saveReminder: Save to record the closures. The messages are already sent.
speedCameraUrs.errBatchRank: Handling all URs at once requires editor level {{level}}.
speedCameraUrs.errNotAllowedBatch: Editing is not allowed right now, nothing was sent.
speedCameraUrs.errNotAllowed: editing is not allowed right now
speedCameraUrs.errDetails: the conversation could not be read
speedCameraUrs.errComment: the message could not be sent
speedCameraUrs.errClose: the message was sent, but the UR could not be closed
speedCameraUrs.skipGone: already closed or no longer editable
speedCameraUrs.skipConversation: a conversation started in the meantime
speedCameraUrs.messageIntro:
Hello,

Thank you for your report.

Fixed speed cameras cannot be shown in Waze in Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
speedCameraUrs.messageBody:
To comply with local regulations, Waze has disabled police reporting for users navigating in Switzerland and Liechtenstein.

All other navigation features, including hazard alerts, traffic information and road closures, remain fully functional.
speedCameraUrs.messageSignature:
Have a nice day and safe travels.
The volunteer editor community
speedCameraUrs.sectionTrafficLights: Traffic lights reported on a freeway ({{count}})
speedCameraUrs.trafficLightNote: MISSING_TRAFFIC_LIGHT URs whose closest road is a freeway: often a speed camera reported as a traffic light. One by one only: open each UR and check it before closing. No message is sent.
speedCameraUrs.dlgFactNoMessage: No message is sent to the reporter.
speedCameraUrs.skipNotFreeway: no longer next to a freeway
